profile: Fresh isolated profile with macros and document-link updates disabled; pdf:writer_pdf_Export
reproduction: For the controlled comparison only, start from the prior DOCX identified above and insert the exact kern element before its five w:sz elements without changing any other uncompressed part bytes.
Render each DOCX with the recorded installed LibreOffice build in a fresh macro/link-disabled profile and pdf:writer_pdf_Export.
Extract bounding boxes with pdftotext -bbox-layout -enc UTF-8 and compare word text, order, page size and boxes to the independently rendered source DOC snapshot.
limitations: This measures all 36 word boxes on one page, including 24 linked-textbox FLOW markers. It does not assert raster equality or other documents, fonts or consumers.
Microsoft Word native validation was not available; w:kern val0 matches this LibreOffice native export/import observation and the explicit MS-DOC zero/off source semantics.
Hashes identify this observed experiment, not stable output goldens; native metadata and ZIP serialization may differ on another run.
The existing native-DOC chain-count recovery and its explicit warnings remain; kerning support does not remove unrelated conversion limitations.
